meta.name: architecture-designer
meta.description: Use when designing new high-level system architecture, reviewing existing designs, or making architectural decisions. Invoke to create architecture diagrams, write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), evaluate technology trade-offs, design component interactions, and plan for scalability. Use for system design, architecture review, microservices structuring, ADR authoring, scalability planning, and infrastructure pattern selection — distinct from code-level design patterns or database-only design tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计系统架构并记录架构决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或评审系统架构并记录决策
copy.tagline_en: Design system architecture and record architectural decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or review system architecture and document decisions

howto.what: 装上此技能后,遇到系统设计任务时,Claude 会先收集功能与非功能需求,再匹配架构模式,最终产出架构图(Mermaid)、技术选型建议、架构决策记录(ADR)以及风险与缓解方案。
howto.when: 当要求设计高层系统架构、审查现有设计或做架构决策时触发;提到“架构”“系统设计”“微服务”等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个电商系统架构,画个 Mermaid 图。
say.note: 会先总结需求,再给出架构图和 ADR。

say.text: 为订单服务写一份 ADR,对比 PostgreSQL 和 MongoDB。
say.note: 会按 ADR 模板输出决策与权衡。

say.text: 评估这个微服务拆分方案的可扩展性和风险。
say.note: 会从架构师角度审查并列出权衡。

howto.what_en: After enabling this skill, when given a system design task, Claude first gathers functional and non-functional requirements, matches architectural patterns, and produces a Mermaid diagram, technology recommendations, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and risks with mitigations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design high-level system architecture, review an existing design, or make an architectural decision; also when you mention keywords like "architecture", "system design", "microservices".

say_en.text: Design an e-commerce system architecture and draw a Mermaid diagram.
say_en.note: It summarizes requirements and outputs diagram and ADRs.

say_en.text: Write an ADR for the order service comparing PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
say_en.note: It will output the decision in ADR format with trade-offs.

say_en.text: Evaluate scalability and risks of this microservices breakdown.
say_en.note: It reviews and lists trade-offs from an architect's view.
